title: D4: interventions as transformations scored over a batch of N dev items re-sampled per iteration; per-item and pooled effects
summary: research/multi.py ItemPool + paired-by-item comparison; --items-per-iter N with --benchmark-items re-samples N dev items each iteration, re-measures the current best on them, reports per-item and pooled effects (findings.per_item_delta, report.multi_item). Tests: MultiItemTests.
